existing_owner_scope: Current source contains bounded source-bound graph proposal paths. Proposal flags remain admitted=false and formalized=false. Source presence does not establish a full corpus execution.

historical_document_observation.scope: Historical report statement read in local source. Not newly rerun, independently recomputed or asserted as current campaign state. A complete source scan is distinct from retaining every physical-occurrence identity.

observation_limits: Hub metadata, root/directory tree listings, READMEs and Dataset Viewer splits/size/first rows were inspected; this is not a full corpus audit.
Viewer URLs were unpinned service endpoints. Their sizes and sampled schemas are current-service observations and were not cryptographically bound to the reported immutable Hub revisions.
Sample rows are not a random sample or an estimate of corpus-wide prevalence.
LFS sizes and digests below are descriptor observations, not independent downloads or byte verification.
No checkpoint qualification, training success, semantic fidelity, formal proof, or corpus admission follows from file presence.
purpose: Bounded planning observation for refresh of existing legal_ir autoformalization roadmap.
recommended_plan_actions: Keep a compatibility manifest across immutable source, span, graph, tokenizer/encoder/decoder, context and Lean generations.
Classify each producer/configuration separately; do not train on diagnostic train storage merely because it is named train.
Recover canonical source occurrence and context bindings before accepting aliases or aggregating definitions.
Publish a separately qualified lossless graph sidecar with stable nodes/edges, source anchors, scoped definitions, modality/exception/time bindings and proof receipt references.
Use embeddings to nominate relationships; admit correspondence only through declared independent checks.
Separate semantic reconstruction, normalized text reconstruction, exact-byte restoration, vector reconstruction and actual proof checks.
Retain unsupported, ambiguous, negative-emission and erroneous examples with explicit target origin and eligibility.
Group holdouts by source section and dependency/definition families to control leakage.
Reuse existing feed/intake/entity-cache proposal owners and refresh the existing canonical plan; do not create a parallel corpus authority.

source_snapshot_context.qualification: Snapshot identifiers supplied by coordinating inspection. This observation does not establish that historical corpus jobs executed either snapshot or that current filesystem files are a clean copy of either.
